accepted_records.statement: September1 2018 is Saturday. Note payment shifts to subsequent Business Day and defines exclusions beyond weekends. A weekday-only conditional calendar givesSep3 due, ten following weekdays endingSep17 and rate-switch sensitivitySep18; additionally assumingSep3 is excluded givesSep4 due, cure endingSep18 and switchSep19. These are explicit sensitivity calendars, not verified NewYork legal calendars or determinations of default.

limitation: These are not determinations of default or verified New York legal calendars. Assumptions: no earlier transfer; unchanged principal/no payments or fees; January 11 accrual start; due day excluded from cure, full tenth Business Day allowed, switch next calendar day; no capitalization at maturity/switch and no anniversary before filing. Complete holiday/bank-closure inputs and controlling notice/waiver/election construction are missing. The 15% rate replaces 10%, with the shared boundary counted once.
summary: All branches end September 27, 2018. The creditor’s asserted September 17 switch gives independently recomputed interest $163,753.85 (249 regular / 10 default days); weekdays only gives September 3 due, September 17 cure end, September 18 switch and $163,443.71 (250/9); additionally excluding September 3 gives September 4 due, September 18 cure end, September 19 switch and $163,133.57 (251/8).
